observations: 6 Energy, 1 Calm Power, 5 Might, Unit, Demacia.
Both static restrictions operate while this unit is at any battlefield; they do not require control of its battlefield.
Opponents can play units only to their base. This is not a movement prohibition.
Spells and abilities cannot ready enemy units and gear; the text does not forbid normal Awakening or entering ready.

implementation_requirements: One live restriction query keyed by affected controller, with source identity and explanatory text for API and UI.
Enforce base-only unit play for Hand, Champion, Hidden, instructed plays and tokens, including conflicting fixed destinations, without affecting gear, movement or non-play board returns.

Block spell/ability Ready for enemy units and gear everywhere; preserve normal Awakening, entry state, legends and runes. Do not filter otherwise legal targets solely because an effect cannot ready them.
Re-evaluate live control and source location at resolution; removing or recalling the Warden ends its restrictions, and multiple Wardens are handled.
Preserve cost payment and independent spell effects; no Ready event or Irelia growth from prevented Ready.
Exercise both seats, actual responses, pending plays, rollback, bot observations, complete games, unobtrusive coaching and readable native previews.
